name: joplin-plugin-note-history-diff
description: Compare two revisions of a Joplin note and see what changed. / Joplin のノートの 2 つの版を比べて、変わったところを表示します。
author: akiratamcat

scripts.test: npm run i18n:compile && npm run i18n:check && node scripts/readme.mjs --check && jest
scripts.dist: npm run i18n:compile && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
